SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.
   B. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   C. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.

3. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   B. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat School administration as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   B. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

6. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.
   B. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.
   D. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   B. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.
   D. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.
   B. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.
   D. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain African Traditional Education and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain School administration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Mining in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
